name: Miami Valley Packaging Solutions
old_description: Miami Valley Packaging Solutions is focused on providing packaging solutions for our customers primarily through corrugated cartons, shipping and storing materials, corrugated boxes, die-cut, partitions, and other specialty packaging. Our goal is to help our customers grow their businesses—increase revenues, decrease costs, and operate more efficiently.
about:
Miami Valley Packaging Solutions operates from Dayton, Ohio, providing custom packaging solutions centered on corrugated cartons, die-cut components, partitions, and specialty packaging. The business focuses on helping customers increase revenues, decrease costs, and operate more efficiently through tailored packaging.

The company designs and produces expendable and returnable packaging, point-of-purchase displays, and retail packaging. Its capabilities include structural design, conversion of plastic corrugated for reusable containers, assembly of foam-integrated packs, and custom delivery scheduling. Strategic partnerships extend its material options to plastic corrugated, foam, and chipboard, allowing integration of multiple substrates into a single solution.

The company serves customers needing expendable packaging, returnable packaging, point-of-purchase displays, and retail packaging, supporting both single-use shipping and closed-loop logistics systems.

Founded on the principle of being a solutions provider—reflected in its name—the firm emphasizes an award-winning design department, creative problem-solving, and end-to-end coordination from design through production to delivery, aiming to align its goals with those of each customer.
